title: Unsupervised Thermodynamics of Molecular Diffusion Models: Action-Operator Semantics and Auditable Free-Energy Readout
abstract: arXiv:2606.30687v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Diffusion models are increasingly utilized for modeling molecular structures and conformational ensembles, yet the thermodynamic meaning of their learned representations and scores remains elusive. To resolve this ambiguity, we introduce a mathematically consistent action-operator framework natively compatible with diffusion models. By defining a fixed molecular environment as a base action $S_0(x)$ and an alchemical perturbation as an operator $O(x)$, standard diffusion noising induces effective noised actions and operators whose gradients and alchemical derivatives are directly represented by the model's learned fields. This rigorous self-consistency enables a ``noisy operator bridge'' capable of reading out free-energy differences ($\Delta F$) from endpoint ensembles and per-frame evaluations. In controlled experiments on alanine dipeptide systems, we show that incorporating physical inductive biases enables partial recovery

translated_title: 分子扩散模型的无监督热力学：作用量-算符语义与可审计的自由能读取
translated_abstract: 扩散模型正日益被用于建模分子结构和构象系综，然而其学习到的表示和得分函数的热力学含义仍然不明确。为了解决这一模糊性，我们引入了一个与扩散模型天然兼容且在数学上自洽的作用量-算符框架。通过将固定的分子环境定义为基础作用量 $S_0(x)$，并将炼金术微扰定义为一个算符 $O(x)$，标准的扩散加噪过程会诱导出加噪后的有效作用量与算符，其梯度和炼金术导数可直接由模型学习到的场来表示。这种严格的自洽性催生了一种“噪声算符桥”，能够从端点系综和逐帧评估中读取自由能差（$\Delta F$）。在丙氨酸二肽体系的受控实验中，我们表明引入物理归纳偏置能够实现部分恢复。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个与扩散模型天然兼容的作用量-算符理论框架，赋予扩散模型学习表示明确的热力学语义，并借助“噪声算符桥”实现对分子体系自由能差的可审计读取。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a mathematically consistent action-operator framework natively compatible with diffusion models, endowing their learned representations with clear thermodynamic semantics and enabling auditable readout of free-energy differences via a "noisy operator bridge."
